intro_body: Every day, Oxford waits — in clinic lobbies, at the gas pump, between sets at the gym. MCTV puts Little & Holland on the screen in those moments with two custom 15-second commercials that play back-to-back on every loop. No skip button, no scrolling past. Just your firm, in front of your neighbors, all month long.

why_points.title: Seen where people wait
why_points.body: 55+ minute average dwell means your message is seen again and again — not once in a scroll.

why_points.title: Two jobs, one slot
why_points.body: One spot builds trust in the name; the other speaks to the moment someone needs a lawyer.

why_points.title: Hyper-local Oxford reach
why_points.body: 44 Oxford and Lafayette County venues — the places your future clients already go.

why_points.title: Done for you
why_points.body: We script, design and produce both spots, refresh them quarterly, and report every play.

concept_note: Concepts are starting points. Final scripts, visuals and disclaimers are written with your team and approved by the firm before anything airs.
rotation_explainer: Your two 15-second commercials run back-to-back in one 30-second slot, so both spots play every loop on every screen in your plan.
compliance_note: We leave room on every end card for any disclaimer the Mississippi Rules of Professional Conduct require, and nothing airs until your firm approves the final files.
